title: Cobblemon Freedom Frontiers
description: Become a Pokemon Ranger! Sail to new destinations, fill your dex to gain special skills and use your mons to build your ranger base!
body:

**The next update is HERE!**

**Want to support the pack while setting up a Minecraft server with your friends? Go to https://shockbyte.com/partner/sihonetv and use discount code SihoneTV25 for a 25% discount!**
![Server Hosting Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1dba84d976b31d0351bc87407b8cb0591c7fe90d.png)

**Important notes!:** 

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Make sure you have at least 4GB-6GB of ram allocated to this pack to avoid crashes and have a smooth experience! More than 6 could introduce stutters during world gen.
- Make sure you're playing the right version! The client version is for playing the game, the server version is exclusively used to run a dedicated server!
- Join our discord server to chat, add suggestions and report bugs!

</details>



**What makes this pack UNIQUE:**

The goal of Freedom Frontiers is to take what makes Cobblemon great and build on to it. While a lot of great packs focus on adding tons of features from Pokemon, we wanted to focus more on making Pokemon feel even more apart of the Minecraft world. Quickly mine block using rock types, grow plants using grass types, and even smelt blocks using fire types; all by using special partner skills.

## The Cobblemon:

- **Interactive Pokemon** (Pokemon will fly through the sky, run away or attack you if you get too close)
- **All The Mons** (Using All The Mons X Mega Showdown, pretty much every mon is here!)
- **Cobblemon Raid Dens** (Unlock Raid Dens by crafting special keys allowing you to capture powerful Legendary and Mega Pokemon)
- **Cobbleworkers** (Create a Ranger Base by placing a pasture block and starting your farm.)
- **Cobbled Levels** (Harsher environments in certain biomes have made the Pokemon living there more powerful. Expect to see high level Pokemon in Cold Biomes and Hot Biomes, and even more powerful Pokemon in the Nether and the End)

## The Quests:

- **Ranger Log** (The Ranger Log, accessible through the inventory screen, will help guide new Rangers through this perilous world. It's divided into 2 sections, Main Quests and Discoveries. If you're ever lost on what to do next, start working on these quests and get rewards)
- **Sail to New Lands** Your Ranger Log will eventually guide you towards crafting your first ship. These are new water mounts that have inventory space.
- **Legendary Monuments** (Travel the land with your trusty Arc Phone to find Legendary Structures that house some of the strongest legendary Pokemon in the game!)
- **Roads** (Important landmarks are dotted with roads. Use your chartering map to create fast travel points along these roads to get around quickly)
- **Survive the Elements** (This pack adds extra survival mechanics. Stay hydrated with canteens and keep warm with campfires and wool armor. Heat management for hot biomes and cold management for cold biomes will be crucial.)


## A New Look:

- **Fresh Player Extension with Animated Eyes** (Revamps player animations)
- **Fresh Animations** (Reanimates every vanilla mob with some fun suprises)
- **Multiple Weather Addons** (Makes weather more cinematic and immersive with sounds and visuals)
- **Biome overhauls for most dimensions**

**AND MUCH MORE!**
